newsitem.title: FINLAND: Sampo falls, support seen at 400 markka.
newsitem.headline: Sampo falls, support seen at 400 markka.

text.p: Finnish insurer Sampo fell sharply on Wednesday on profit-taking and on news that NatWest had lowered its recommendation for the stock, but brokers saw the downside limited with a strong support at about 400 markka.
At 1600/1400 GMT, Sampo traded at 420.00 markka, down 19.50 markka or more than four percent. Trade was modest at 3.5 million markka.
"(Sampo) could test 400 markka in the short term, but it is not likely to go below that," one broker said.
Another broker said the slump in Sampo was only temporary and the stock was likely to resume its upward trend soon.
"If the market will continue strong, Sampo will go higher," he said, adding that bright prospects for the voluntary pension insurance business would support Sampo.
NatWest said earlier it had downgraded its recommendation on Sampo to reduce from hold.
